name: Inventory Change Scaled by Sales
construction: Annual change in inventories divided by annual sales, both from Compustat.
reason: Both use change in inventory, but proposal scales by sales.

name: Quality of Earnings
construction: Calculate the ratio of a firm's operating cash flow to its net income.
reason: Both use cash flow to earnings/profitability, but denominator differs.

name: Operating Lease Obligations Ratio
construction: Estimated present value of operating lease obligations (from footnotes) divided by total assets.
reason: No predictor uses operating lease obligations or off-balance-sheet debt.

name: Product Innovation Score
construction: Score firms based on the number of new product launches reported in industry publications and press releases over the past year.
reason: Both use innovation proxies, but construction differs (products vs. patents).

name: CEO Tenure
construction: Number of years the current CEO has been in position
reason: No library predictor uses CEO tenure.

name: Litigation Risk
construction: Number of ongoing lawsuits divided by market capitalization
reason: No litigation or legal risk variable in library.

name: Environmental Violations
construction: Count the number of environmental regulatory violations reported over the past 5 years.
reason: No library predictor uses environmental violations.

name: Accruals
construction: Calculate the difference between net income and cash flow from operations for the previous fiscal year.
reason: Standard accruals construction: net income minus cash flow from operations.

name: Net Insider Buying
construction: Sum net insider purchases (Form 4 filings, SEC) over the past 12 months, scaled by shares outstanding.
reason: No library predictor for net insider buying.

name: Supplier Concentration
construction: Percentage of total purchases from the top three suppliers, calculated annually from firm disclosures.
reason: HerfAsset is industry asset concentration; both relate to supplier concentration.

name: Employee Productivity
construction: Annual sales revenue divided by the number of employees, both sourced from Compustat at fiscal year-end.
reason: Cash productivity is related to employee productivity.

name: Board Director Age Dispersion
construction: Standard deviation of ages of board directors, measured annually from proxy statements.
reason: No library predictor uses board age dispersion.

name: Green Score
construction: Environmental sustainability score from third-party ESG rating agencies
reason: No library predictor uses ESG or environmental scores.

name: Product Quality
construction: Consumer survey data on perceived product quality, averaged over the last quarter.
reason: No library predictor uses consumer product quality surveys.

name: Litigation Exposure
construction: Collect data on pending lawsuits, normalize and rank across all companies.
reason: No library predictor uses litigation exposure data.

name: Share Repurchase Frequency
construction: Number of quarterly reductions in shares outstanding (Compustat item CSHO) over the past 12 quarters.
reason: Both capture share buyback activity, but frequency vs. amount.

name: Customer Concentration Risk
construction: Percentage of total sales accounted for by the largest single customer, as disclosed in 10-K filings.
reason: No customer concentration or single-customer risk predictor.

name: Employee Turnover
construction: Number of employees leaving over a given period divided by the total number of employees
reason: No employee turnover or similar HR metric in library.

name: Green Investment
construction: Calculate the proportion of a company's total investment that is dedicated to green, environmentally friendly technologies or practices.
reason: No library predictor uses green investment proportion.

name: Patent Count
construction: Count the number of patents owned by a firm.
reason: PatentsRD uses patent counts, but scaled by R&D; core signal similar.

name: Market Share Growth
construction: Change in a firm's market share within its industry over the past year. Data from industry reports and firm sales figures.
reason: No library predictor uses market share growth within industry.

name: Unrecognized Pension Liability Ratio
construction: Unrecognized pension liabilities divided by market capitalization, as disclosed in footnotes of annual reports.
reason: Both relate to pension liabilities, but not unrecognized portion.

name: Advertising Expenditure Ratio
construction: Annual advertising expenditure / total sales
reason: Same as AdExp: Advertising Expense to sales.

name: Advertising Efficiency Ratio
construction: Total Sales divided by Advertising Expenses, calculated annually from financial statements.
reason: Both relate sales to advertising expense, but inverse construction.

name: Supply Chain Efficiency
construction: Calculate the ratio of completed orders to total orders over the past year.
reason: No library predictor uses order completion ratio or supply chain efficiency.

name: C-Suite Diversity
construction: Measure the racial and gender diversity in the company's C-suite leadership using publicly available biographical data.
reason: No library predictor uses C-suite diversity or similar data.

name: Employee Growth Rate
construction: Calculate the annual growth rate in the number of employees from COMPUSTAT's employment data over the last three years.
reason: Annual employee growth rate matches hire's construction.

name: Dividend Growth Stability
construction: Standard deviation of dividend per share growth rate over the past five years.
reason: No library predictor uses dividend growth stability.

name: CEO-CFO Pay Ratio
construction: CEO total compensation / CFO total compensation
reason: No library predictor uses CEO-CFO pay ratio.

name: R&D to Revenue Ratio
construction: The ratio of research and development expenditure to total revenue, both sourced from the company's annual financial statements.
reason: Both use R&D scaled by firm size; denominator differs.

name: Advertising Intensity
construction: Total advertising expenditure divided by total sales, calculated annually from firm financial statements.
reason: AdExp is advertising expense; advertising intensity is AdExp/sales.

name: Insider Loan Guarantee Exposure
construction: Indicator variable equal to 1 if insiders have guaranteed company debt (disclosed in proxy or 10-K), 0 otherwise.
reason: Insider loan guarantees not covered in library predictors.

name: Employee Satisfaction
construction: Compute an index based on employee reviews from surveys. Use external survey data if available.
reason: No library predictor uses employee satisfaction or survey-based index.

name: Employee Satisfaction
construction: Measure using aggregate employee reviews and ratings on job websites over the past six months.
reason: No library predictor uses employee satisfaction data.

name: Capital Expenditure Volatility
construction: Standard deviation of capital expenditures over the past five years
reason: No library predictor uses capex volatility.

name: Dividend Momentum
construction: Calculate the percentage change in dividends per share over the past 3 years using data from company financial statements.
reason: Both use dividend growth/momentum over time.

name: Accruals
construction: Calculate the difference between net income and cash flow from operations, scaled by total assets.
reason: Standard accruals definition; matches Accruals in library.

name: Relative Insider Ownership Change
construction: Change in the percentage of shares held by officers and directors over the most recent fiscal year.
reason: No library predictor uses insider ownership change.

name: Earnings Announcement Drift Sensitivity
construction: Stock’s average abnormal return over 3-day windows around the past four quarterly earnings announcements.
reason: Both use abnormal returns around earnings announcements.

name: Cybersecurity Risk
construction: Data on a company's number of reported cybersecurity incidents. Higher values indicate more incidents.
reason: No library predictor uses cybersecurity incident data.
